purpose: Test whether external mono supervision improves same-library candidate ranking and measured P2 confirmation yield over same-input scratch and strong simple controls.
environment: maestro; CPU first; no dependency installation or production src changes
outcome_scope: Adaptive exploratory Jaaks development; not a fresh confirmation set, not STATE, not authenticated dynamic state.

source_candidates.name: GDSC2 release 8.5 fitted mono dose response
source_candidates.verified_now: Header, metadata-only identity/design census and actual SHA256; structure/alias identity, licence, transform, fit independence and QC not yet authenticated.
do_not_infer: shared drug IDs prove identical drug bottles
out-of-range fitted IC50 is an observed threshold or automatically censored

source_candidates.name: GDSC public baseline PROGENy
source_candidates.inputs: 14 static external baseline RNA-derived programme scores; no TF in first candidate
source_candidates.meaning: Retrospectively available cell-line covariates, not current culture state or experimentally measured pathway activity

metadata_census_executed.access: Streaming XLSX parser inspected cell values only in columns A,B,C,D,E,F,H,I,N,O; LN_IC50/AUC/RMSE/Z_SCORE values were not inspected.
metadata_census_executed.composite_rule: 1032|1372 is not one single drug; no forced expansion or mono pseudo-observation.
metadata_census_executed.limits: Pre-QC metadata availability only. Exact SIDM exclusion is not authenticated alias/culture exclusion. Distinct curve IDs do not prove independent samples or fits.

S0_metadata_before_labels.allowed_reads: Source receipts, headers, identity/design/group columns only
S0_metadata_before_labels.mapping: SIDM exact first; compound ID plus original metadata/structure entity check. Ambiguity stays unmapped; do not delete Jaaks menu candidates.
S0_metadata_before_labels.coverage_rule: Record eligible mono training records per drug after identity exclusions; uncovered drugs remain scratch-initialized in both models with coverage flags. Covered-drug subgroup is descriptive, never a replacement primary menu.
required_resolutions: LN_IC50 concentration unit and log convention
S0_metadata_before_labels.gate: Freeze complete observation and split rules with code/input hashes before mono target reads. If fitted-label independence cannot be authenticated, label experiment fitted-parameter transfer and retain provenance limitation. No silent conversion to raw or censored observations.

splits.primary_mono_training_exclusion: Exclude every Jaaks 125 SIDM and authenticated aliases/COSMIC duplicates from mono training and validation; exclude any Jaaks mono controls reused in GDSC2 by raw/fit IDs.
splits.mono_validation: Fixed 20% of remaining cell entities, hash/SIDM-based; all duplicate curves/fit groups in one side; no combo labels in selection.
splits.combo_development: 5 tissue-stratified folds of HD=64, seed20261004; complete cell line, both orientations and all physical/fit groups stay together.
splits.inner_selection: Within outer training only. Rebuild history, standardization, strong-simple selection and all learned values for each inner fold.
splits.E61: Exposed exploratory transport only, read after successor config freeze; never tune based on E.
splits.new_pair_claim: Not primary. Needs a separate whole-pair-across-cells holdout protocol.
splits.limited_coverage_fallback: Publish gaps and one separately frozen transductive amendment if needed; never silently restore E mono labels.

model.cell_inputs: 14 PROGENy coordinates, standardized on allowed mono/combo training covariates only, parameters exported
model.drug_inputs: Verified drug identity, shared vocabulary; no unknown mechanism sign converted to inhibition
model.mono: r=z W; drug embedding e_a; fitted LN_IC50 head b0+b_a+r dot e_a
model.combo_heads: Shared orientation call-logit and continuous delta-Emax heads; evaluate each orientation to obtain four outputs; direction sign changes under anchor/library swap.
model.prior: Fold-legal shrunk historical pair p_s,p_v,y_s,y_v; training-row priors exclude their own entire cell line
model.relative_signal: Centre g over target candidate menu before adding fold-legal priors; probability sigmoid(logit prior+centred g); continuous prior+centred g
model.symmetry: Unordered blocks symmetric; orientation block is explicitly antisymmetric. Do not force two different anchor-dose experiments to have identical output.
model.forbidden_formula: Do not add mono IC50/AUC to synergy. Do not use product of unmatched predicted mono outputs as observed Bliss viability.
model.training_config_before_labels: One optimizer, fixed seeds [11,23,47], fixed mono and combo step counts, learning rate and L2 determined by synthetic stability/preflight and frozen; equal combo training budget across all learned arms. No family search.
model.loss: Author-appropriate fitted mono LN_IC50 loss after S0 resolution; combo BCE(true author Synergy) plus MSE(continuous delta-Emax standardized within training), equal orientation and cell-line weights, missing label masks; no E scales.
model.compute_scope: No API required; if implementation uses APIs later, log actual backend and cost, do not call their result STATE.

arms.train: Mono train W/e then identically fine-tune combo W/e/g
Same architecture, input covariates, combo examples, steps and seeds; W/e random initialisation, no mono training
Select original six simple ranks within inner development fold, with same history budget
Prior imported candidate-specific ID x background interaction with same folds; acknowledges already tried structure
Fixed drug mapping permutation in mono only, then same combo fine-tune
Fixed cell-background permutation in mono only, then same combo fine-tune

campaign.primary_history: 4 HD histories per tissue; seeds11,23,47; fold-legal histories only
campaign.rule: Original P2, two rounds, fp30, M=ceil(menu/5), original QC-conditioned menu, author Synergy, exact existing tie-breaking
campaign.first_stage_changes: Screen ordering only; verification order from same strong-simple baseline across all arms
campaign.unit: Target cell line; average role assignments and history seeds within it
campaign.missing: Visible missing/failed/unexecuted reasons; no prediction substituted for observed response
campaign.resources: Cap/spent/screens/verifications plus compute, wait and layout scope; hypothetical per-pair layout never called demonstrated physical saving

metrics.primary: Outer-fold measured double-orientation confirmed yield, mono_pretrained vs strong_simple and scratch_same_input in n4
secondary: actual action changes and correct/wrong changes
metrics.intervals: Paired tissue-stratified cell-line bootstrap with both roles/seeds averaged; conditional exploratory intervals. Line x pair sensitivity for broader pair scope; no physical independent-culture CI without authentication.
metrics.selection_limit: Adaptive project exposure persists. Nested folds reduce in-study tuning bias, not historical research selection bias.

required: n4 outer-fold gain point estimate >=5% vs both scratch and strong simple
paired cell-line intervals lower >0 for both primary controls
positive attributable advantage over both mono permutations
at least2 of3 history seeds positive
no extra first-round screens or endpoint redefinition
continue_gate.precision_fail: Mark unresolved, estimate required independent confirmation precision before buying or opening further outcomes; no test threshold changes.
continue_gate.repair_limit: At most one development-only implementation/target-alignment repair in a new frozen version; original failures retained.

stages.deliverable: Mono model, matched scratch implementation, synthetic contract tests, frozen training/config manifest
stages.outcome_access: GDSC2 mono only after S0 freeze

stages.deliverable: Nested HD development predictions/campaign logs and paired comparisons
stages.outcome_access: Exposed Jaaks only; successor logged ticket

stages.deliverable: Fixed-config E61 exploratory transport and full negative-result ledger
stages.outcome_access: Exposed Jaaks E after development config freeze

stages.deliverable: If gate passes: separately frozen direct-real-screen feedback diagnostic and untouched-source qualification
stages.outcome_access: No Vis outcomes under this protocol
